Title: Nitin's Day

Cast

1. Nitin - 30 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Pallavi - 60 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Rajesh - 64 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nitin stands in the living room. Pallavi stands near him.]

Nitin: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nitin pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Pallavi: "Good job, Nitin!"

[Nitin sips red wine.]

Nitin: "I'm ready!"

[Nitin drinks a beer.]

Nitin: "Yes, of course."

[Nitin staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Nitin: "Yes, all right."

[Nitin and Mother clink their glasses.]

Nitin: "Yes, all right."

[Nitin walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Pallavi: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Nitin stands on the road. Pallavi and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "What a nice place."

[Nitin starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Pallavi: "I knew it!"

[Nitin is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Rajesh (surprised): "What next?"

[Nitin steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Nitin: "What a day to remember!"
